content: E mengeiong KAUN-O en ketin kakaun kupwur en nanmwarki kan rasehng eh kin ketin kaweid pwilipwilahn piletik ehu.
Ke kak medemedewe me mehkoaros me ke kin wia me pwung, ahpw ke en tamataman me KAUN-O kin ketin tetehk nsenomw kan.
Wiahda dahme pwung oh pahrek; met kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O laud sang omw pahn patohwan meirongkihong dipwisou kan.
Lamalam ile oh aklapalap kin kaunda aramas suwed kan, oh met wia dihp ehu.
Wiahda omw koasoandi ni keneinei, ke ahpw pahn ahneki dipwisou tohto; ma ke pahn pwurur, omw dipwisou sohte pahn tohto.
Reken dipwisou me ke ahneki sang ni tiahk en mwersuwed pahn mwadangete sohrala, ahpw mwohn ar pahn kahluwaiukalahng mehla.
Aramas suwed kan pahn pein mehkihla arail eikek; re kin soikala wia dahme pwung.
Aramas dipada kin weweid nan ahl pirek; me mwakelekel kin wiewia dahme pwung.
Kousoan pohn pwelengen ihmw ehu mwahusang iang kousoan nan ihmw ehu me lih pwopwoud lokaia tohto men mihmi loale.
Aramas suwed kin iouki mehkot suwed ahnsou koaros; sohte emen re kin mahkohng.
Ahnsou me aklapalap emen kin ale kalokepe, me pweipwei men pil kin ale padahk sang ie. Me loalokong pahn ale padahk me kohieng.
Koht, me ketin pwung, kin mwahngih dahme wiewiawi nan imwen me suwed akan, e ahpw pahn ketin kauweirailla.
Ma ke soikala ngilen peksawas en me semwehmwe kan, sohte me pahn rong ngilen omw peksawas.
Ma emen pahn lingeringer pahmw, kisakis rir pahn kameleileidi.
Ahnsou me pwunglahn mehkot kin wiawi, me mwahu kan kin perenda, ahpw me suwed kan kin sohla ar koapworopwor.
Mehla kin awiawih mehmen me pahn salongasang lamalam mwahu.
Mourenki kamadipw, wain, oh kisin tungoal kaselel kan sohte kak kakepwehpwehiukala.
Aramas suwed kan kin kahrehiong pein irail lokolok me re kin song en kahrehiong aramas mwahu kan.
Kousoan nan sapwtehn mwahusang mihmi rehn lih pwopwoud men me kalap lipwoar oh kaulim.
Aramas loalokong kin ahneki reken dipwisou, ahpw me pweipwei kan kin mwadangete kesehla mwahl neirail mwohni kan.
Kadek oh lelepek ke ahpw pahn mour werei; meteikan pahn waunekin uhk oh wia mwahu ong uhk.
Kaunen sounpei koahiek men kak kalowehdi kahnimw ehu me sounpei kehlail sinsile, oh kauwehla kehl me re koapworopworki.
Ma ke men kadohwanowei sang uhk kahpwal, kanahieng omw lokaia kan.
Kasalehiong ie emen aramas me kin nohn kesempwalki pein ih, I ahpw pahn kasalehiong uhk emen me aklapalap, pohnmwahso oh serekeileng.
Aramas pohnkahke men me sohte men doadoahk, e kaukauwe pein ih;
ihte me e kin medemedewe dahme e anahne. Aramas pwung kin kak kihwei oh kihwei ni sapan.
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki aramas suwed kan ar kin wiahiong meirong, ahpw mehlel ni ar kin wia meirong ni lamalam suwed.
Sohte me kin kamehlele kadehdehn aramas likamw, ahpw lokaiahn aramas me mie audepe kin pweida.
Aramas pwung kin wehwehki pein irail; a me suwed akan kin mwomwmwomwe ni uwen ar kak me re ese.
Loalokong en aramas, marain, oh erpit sohte wia sawas ehu ma KAUN-O ketin uhwong uhk.
Ke kak kaunopada oahs akan ong mahwen, ahpw KAUN-O me kin ketin kupwurehda ihs me pahn kana.
